svg.text: Concept Floor Plan and Layout Schematic, version 2
Option A shown: two equal blood collection rooms, each with its own specimen fridge. Option B (one large room with clinical privacy curtain) is in the inset.
Typical rectangle 18.5 m x 15.6 m = 288.6 sqm gross internal. Site Brief range about 257 to 290 sqm. Scale 1:100 at A1 (see scale bar).
Subject to site survey, architect and NCC compliance.
back-of-house corridor, staff and service only, 1.2 m
Client route: entry, lounge, clinical corridor, collection room door
Staff route: staff entry and staff room to clinical and back-of-house corridors
Dirty route: clinical waste and soiled linen to the service door (staff only)
Staff reach the staff room from the clinical corridor or the back-of-house corridor, never through the dirty zone (red tint).
Dirty zone: service entry, clinical waste, dirty linen
C = centrifuge. Dashed C in Room 2 = space kept for a second unit (quantity TO CONFIRM with the pathology partner).
AREA SCHEDULE (drawn sqm against reference target)
Pathology partner brief; venue room schedule
Venue room schedule; AusHFG room 12 min
Circulation (clinical corridor, staff corridor, arrival lobby)
Total gross internal (18.5 m x 15.6 m)
Both collection rooms are drawn at 19.0 sqm, the middle of the pathology partner brief range of 18 to 20 sqm (the 9 sqm figure is the partner's
minimum floor, and AusHFG shows 12 sqm for a single enclosed collection room). Each room carries its own specimen fridge, handwash basin, bench,
chair, recovery recliner and documentation bench. Hair and nails are drawn at 5 to 6 sqm per station. All areas are indicative.
OPTION B INSET: ONE LARGE COLLECTION ROOM WITH CLINICAL PRIVACY CURTAIN
clinical privacy curtain (ceiling track, floor to ceiling)
Same equal-size logic as Option A: each bay keeps the 19.0 sqm,
its own under-counter specimen fridge, handwash basin, recovery
recliner and documentation bench; the dividing wall is replaced
by a full-height clinical curtain on a ceiling track. Doors to
the clinical corridor and the back-of-house corridor are as in
Option A. Curtain gives visual privacy only. Sound privacy is lower
than two walled rooms (to confirm with the pathology partner).
Concept only, not for construction; subject to site survey, architect and NCC compliance. GTT Center Perth. Drawing date 2026-10-17, version 2.
